lines.x: Papua New Guinea's Parliament opened an inquiry into foreign exchange shortages and FATF grey-listing to assess their impact on trade and capital investment.
Global mining giant Rio Tinto committed $370 million to remediate long-standing environmental and social impacts linked to the legacy Panguna mine in Papua New Guinea.

K92 Mining achieved a record-breaking third quarter, generating its highest quarterly throughput during its Stage 3 processing plant ramp-up in Papua New Guinea and crossing one million cumulative gold equivalent ounces produced to date.
ANZ Research reported that Papua New Guinea's annual inflation reached 7%, its highest level since 2011, raising consumer cost pressures ahead of the holidays.
